correctness.rationale: The published reduced Świątkowski quasi-isomorphism permits the explicit weight-three free chain model. The attached verifier constructs all 14,080 degree-three columns, obtains 13,970 distinct mod-two pivots, checks closure of every one of 700 signed geometric tori, and constructs 110 integral unit pivots with a determinant-one coordinate minor. Rank equality plus saturation proves H3 is precisely their lattice. All short tori are separately reduced against the first 100 triangle pivots, giving a free ten-dimensional quotient. The complete verifier was executed on the included files with the stated success marker.

value.rationale: The graph is a canonical Platonic graph dual to a previously studied three-particle graph. The result answers a natural geometric generation question, not an arbitrary slice: all 100 disjoint-triangle tori are primitive and all quadrilateral/pentagonal variants add no class, whereas exactly ten primitive missing directions first appear from hexagons. The threshold is the maximal possible cycle length for three vertex-disjoint cycles on 12 vertices and supplies complete integral top-degree homology, not just an experimental rank.
